author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1967-11-24 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Are we not the same being?
context_before: Now, if I dwell in you and the Father dwells in me, is not the Father in you? And if you are in me and I am in everyone, is not the Father in everyone?
context_after: Will not the same infinite son call us father? Those who believe that Jesus Christ was a man who lived 2000 years ago cannot comprehend a cosmic Christ, dwelling in all, who is God the Father. But God, the Father of all life, is housed in every individual. And one day He will unveil Himself, not as another, but as the one in whom He reveals Himself!
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from Truth, The Word Of God (1967-11-24).
